   156→    /// Handle incoming call notifications.

   158→    private func handleCallNotification(notificationType: RtcNotificationType,
   159→                                        rtcNotifyEventID: String,
   160→                                        timestamp: Timestamp,
   161→                                        expirationTimestamp: Timestamp,
   162→                                        roomID: String,
   163→                                        roomDisplayName: String) async -> NotificationProcessingResult {
   164→        // Handle incoming VoIP calls, show the native OS call screen
   165→        // https://developer.apple.com/documentation/callkit/sending-end-to-end-encrypted-voip-calls
   166→        //
   167→        // The way this works is the following:
   168→        // - the NSE receives the notification and decrypts it
   169→        // - checks if it's still time relevant (max 10 seconds old) and whether it should ring
   170→        // - otherwise it goes on to show it as a normal notification
   171→        // - if it should ring then it discards the notification but invokes `reportNewIncomingVoIPPushPayload`
   172→        // so that the main app can handle it
   173→        // - the main app picks this up in `PKPushRegistry.didReceiveIncomingPushWith` and
   174→        // `CXProvider.reportNewIncomingCall` to show the system UI and handle actions on it.
   175→        // N.B. this flow works properly only when background processing capabilities are enabled
   176→        guard notificationType == .ring else {
   177→            MXLog.info("Non-ringing call notification, handling as push notification")
   178→            return .shouldDisplay
   179→        }
   180→        
   181→        // Check to see if a call is still ongoing
   182→        if let room = userSession.roomForIdentifier(roomID) { // Try to get call details from the room info
   183→            if !room.hasActiveRoomCall() { // If I don't have an active call wait a bit and make sure
   184→                let expiringTask = ExpiringTaskRunner {
   185→                    await withCheckedContinuation { [weak self] continuation in
   186→                        self?.roomInfoObservationToken = room.subscribeToRoomInfoUpdates(listener: SDKListener { info in
   187→                            if info.hasRoomCall {
   188→                                MXLog.info("Received room info update and the room has an active call now.")
   189→                                continuation.resume()
   190→                            } else {
   191→                                MXLog.info("Received a room info update but the room still doesn't have an ongoing call.")
   192→                            }
   193→                        })
   194→                    }
   195→                }
   196→                
   197→                try? await expiringTask.run(timeout: .seconds(5)) // Wait 5 seconds or just use whatever is available
   198→                
   199→                guard room.hasActiveRoomCall() else {
   200→                    MXLog.info("The room no longer has an ongoing call, handling as push notification")
   201→                    return .shouldDisplay
   202→                }
   203→            }
   204→        } else { // Otherwise fallback to the old timeout mechanism
   205→            let timestamp = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(timestamp / 1000))
   206→            
   207→            guard abs(timestamp.timeIntervalSinceNow) < ElementCallServiceNotificationDiscardDelta else {
   208→                MXLog.info("Call notification is too old, handling as push notification")
   209→                return .shouldDisplay
   210→            }
   211→        }
   212→        
   213→        let expirationDate = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(expirationTimestamp / 1000))
   214→        let payload = [ElementCallServiceNotificationKey.roomID.rawValue: roomID,
   215→                       ElementCallServiceNotificationKey.roomDisplayName.rawValue: roomDisplayName,
   216→                       ElementCallServiceNotificationKey.expirationDate.rawValue: expirationDate,
   217→                       ElementCallServiceNotificationKey.rtcNotifyEventID.rawValue: rtcNotifyEventID] as [String: Any]
   218→        
   219→        do {
   220→            try await CXProvider.reportNewIncomingVoIPPushPayload(payload)
   221→            MXLog.info("Call notification delegated to CallKit")
   222→        } catch {
   223→            MXLog.error("Failed reporting voip call with error: \(error). Handling as push notification")
   224→            return .shouldDisplay
   225→        }
   226→        
   227→        return .processedShouldDiscard
   228→    }
